llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are internally consistent with a remote IT risk assessment API: it only needs curl and an API key and instructs the agent to collect user-provided maturity ratings and POST them to portal.toolweb.in.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the declared requirements: a single API key (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) and curl are appropriate for a hosted assessment service. No unrelated binaries or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to gather maturity-level inputs from the user, create a sessionId, and POST a JSON payload to https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment — this stays within the stated purpose. Note: user-provided security posture data will be transmitted to the provider.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or downloaded by the skill itself, minimizing install risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment secret is required (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) and it is used as the API credential in the documented curl call. The requested env var is proportional to a hosted API integration; treat the key as a sensitive secret.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request system persistence or elevated privileges. It does not modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill sends the maturity ratings and any user-provided assessment data to portal.toolweb.in using the TOOLWEB_API_KEY. That is expected behavior, but you should only install it if you trust that external service. Before installing: verify the provider (portal.toolweb.in), read their privacy/retention and pricing terms, limit the API key scope if possible, avoid entering highly sensitive secrets (passwords, private keys) into the assessment prompts, and monitor usage of the API key. If you need an entirely local assessment (no external transmission), this hosted skill is not appropriate.
